name: Sovel HiFi · 声律
originalPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: app icon concept for SONA, a refined cross-platform local HiFi music player for Android music players and iOS. Produce ONE square 1024x1024 icon master, a single symbol, centered front view. Entire canvas is the icon, full bleed near-black charcoal #151617 background, without an outer border, without an app tile floating on a larger background, without rounded external corners (the OS mask will be applied separately). Dominant mark must occupy about 60% of the width, remain clear at 48px, ample consistent negative space. Restrained champagne gold #D5B782 with warm light highlights, premium understated contemporary music hardware sensibility, subtle depth and satin light but clean graphic edges. No words, no SONA wordmark, no letters except when requested below, no watermark, no device mockup, no UI, no comparison grid. Never resemble Apple Music, Spotify, Beats, or a known brand logo.
Design direction B — 声律: A bold original soundwave emblem built from exactly five separate vertical rounded capsules. Vary the heights into a graceful asymmetric rising and falling rhythm, with a tall center column and shorter outer columns; retain generous black gaps. Each capsule is a restrained champagne-gold satin bar with a slight sculptural highlight, not neon. Compact flowing waveform silhouette, no enclosing circle. Very clear at tiny sizes, modern and disciplined, evocative of a premium amplifier's level meter. No letters or music note.
foregroundPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: Android adaptive app icon foreground. Edit target: attached SONA option B gold five-bar soundwave app icon. Remove ONLY the black/charcoal background and all background shadows, making it fully transparent. Preserve exactly the five individual golden rounded capsules, their satin gold texture, lighting, positions, widths, heights, relative spacing and overall design. Preserve the original square full canvas and the symbol's original center and margins; do not enlarge or crop the mark. No new design, no text, no border, no rounded outer tile. Output a genuinely transparent RGBA PNG with five gold capsules floating on transparency.
notes: iOS and legacy icons retain the selected original. Android foreground is a transparent derivative with safe-area padding. The themed monochrome drawable uses the same alpha silhouette.
